stem: Why does Frank become upset about the waffle contest?

options.label: A
options.text: He realizes that parents will make the waffles.

options.label: B
options.text: He hears his classmates share ideas for their waffles.

options.label: C
options.text: His waffle display begins to fall apart.

options.label: D
options.text: His waffle idea has been kept secret for too long.
